about.headline: A focused software company, not a slide deck.
about.lead: GOALGUS LTD is a single-member limited company based in Sofia. We design, build, and maintain digital products for businesses that need dependable engineering — not freelancers who disappear after the first deploy.
body: We work across the full stack: interface, application logic, APIs, content systems, email, and production hosting.
Our preference is long partnerships — launch, then keep the product healthy with measured improvements.

founder.name: Stiliyan Stoyanov
founder.intro: I am a software architect and hands-on engineering lead focused on turning complex business processes into reliable products. My experience spans SaaS, fintech, automotive data, print manufacturing, cloud platforms and applied AI.
founder.downloads_lead: PDF versions tailored for different conversations — pick the one that fits.
founder.cta_lead: Need architecture, delivery leadership, or a full-stack partner from Sofia?
founder.note: Outside engineering I write and produce original music — about 100 songs — and have contributed to music-video work for Bulgarian bands.

experience.role: Founder & Lead Software Engineer / Solution Architect
bullets: Own technical architecture and hands-on engineering for a multi-tenant automotive customer data platform spanning Laravel, Next.js, data ingestion, telephony and AI.
Directed five contract developers: designs, specs, integration contracts, reviews and critical fixes.
Built AWS async workflows with SQS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes/EKS and Argo CD; multi-provider SMS/voice and LLM integrations.
Technical leadership in a seven-developer team for an e-commerce SaaS platform supporting ~3,000 online stores.
Led upgrades Laravel 8→12, PHP 7→8.3 and Vue 2→3 with production-safe rollout.
Built AI Copilot workflows for reporting, campaigns and inventory-aware assistance.
Founded a Bulgaria-based engineering company delivering backend architecture, integrations and technical leadership for international clients.
Led five developers building publishing, print-production and customer communication software for Dutch clients.
Architected self-service design studios and workflows for print prep, mail, SMS, email and delivery.
Regular on-site planning with Netherlands stakeholders.
Led backend initiatives for international consumer lending on PHP/Phalcon.
Integrated credit bureaus in Poland, North Macedonia and Colombia via SOAP and REST.
Built internal communication workflows and lending calculation systems.
Co-built a Laravel/WordPress print manufacturing platform with a configurable product calculator.
Automated quotation and production planning from inventory, machine capacity and shipments.
Led migration of a trading platform backend from CodeIgniter to Laravel; guided PHP and frontend engineers.
Designed PHP client services integrated with a C# layer for MetaTrader 4/5.
Developed a browser-based retail/POS platform covering cashiers, inventory, sales and reporting.
